title: The 4 Tests to Hear God Without Overthinking
hook: Is it God, me, or fear? Use these four tests.
script: Is it God, me, or fear? Use these four tests. When a thought nudges your heart, run it through a simple grid. Scripture test: does it agree with the Bible? (2 Tim 3:16) Christ-likeness test: does it sound like the Shepherd leading, not shaming? (John 10:27) Counsel test: would wise, godly people confirm it? (Prov 11:14) Fruit and peace test: does it grow love, joy, self-control, and let Christ’s peace rule? (Gal 5:22; Col 3:15) If it fails, pause. If it passes, take the next small step. God isn’t hiding; He’s guiding. Save this and replay until the grid lives in you.

title: Watch the 4-Box Grid on a Real Decision
hook: If you’re stuck choosing, watch this grid in action.
script: If you’re stuck choosing, watch this grid in action. Big choice: new job in another city or stay and serve here? I pray, then a thought: stay and build roots. Scripture test: it doesn’t oppose God’s Word; it honors stewardship and loving people (2 Tim 3:16). Christ-likeness: it nudges humility, service, and patience, not ego or fear (John 10:27). Counsel: two mature believers say the reasons sound wise (Prov 11:14). Fruit and peace: picturing staying brings steady peace and growing love; picturing leaving feels like restless striving (Gal 5:22; Col 3:15). Result: I stay, take a faithful next step, and watch for confirming fruit.

title: A 24-Hour Plan to Recognize God’s Voice
hook: If God feels silent, try this for one day.
script: If God feels silent, try this for one day. Find five quiet minutes and pray, “Speak, Lord; your servant is listening” (1 Sam 3:9). Write the first clear, Christ-like thought that comes. Scripture test: does it agree with the Bible? Christ-likeness test: would Jesus say this? Counsel: text a trusted believer for quick feedback (Prov 11:14). Then wait—let the peace of Christ referee your heart (Col 3:15) while you notice the fruit that thought produces through the day (Gal 5:22). If it stirs anxiety or compromise, release it. If it brings love, joy, and steady peace, obey the next small step. Repeat tomorrow and watch clarity grow.
